brief.text: Closed-End Funds feature prominently across both tables, led by BPRE with the day's largest cluster total at $41.6 million, alongside activity in CCAP and three individual filings by Saba Capital Management in ECF ($542,390), DSM ($161,554), and MXF ($970,639). Six Flags Entertainment (FUN) accounts for the next largest cluster total at $34.9 million across three insiders, which includes a single $4.28 million entry from Director Rehan Jaffer. Meanwhile, breadth of activity peaks at Enovis Corp (ENOV) and Suncrete, Inc. (RMIX), where an unusual group of five separate insiders recorded filings at each company.
